style: Wide illustration in the style of a vintage Mexican screen-print poster, flat bold shapes with slightly misregistered ink layers, visible grain and halftone texture on cream paper, limited ink palette of coral red, turquoise, mustard yellow and deep indigo, playful tender romantic mood, no text, people never show a visible face.
